summary: Tested Safety Portal Phase 3+4+5 (Fire Extinguishers, Documents, Training, Employee Profile, Weekly Digest, Admin Safety Overview) and HR cross-portal read. Backend: 29/30 passing. Frontend: all 5 new Safety tiles enabled & routes load with cyan-700 accent, HR Safety Records read-only tile works (no write buttons present). One real backend bug found: /api/safety/digest/send returns sent:true in preview env even though AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false — the email wrapper silently no-ops without raising, so the endpoint cannot tell apart 'actually sent' vs 'preview-stub'. Per spec it must return sent:false in preview.

minor.issue: Returns sent:true in preview env where AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false. The _safety_send_email wrapper in server.py logs a stub and returns silently (no exception), so the endpoint's `sent = True` after `await send_email_fn(...)` is wrong. Per spec it should be sent:false unless email was actually dispatched. Fix: have wrapper return a truthy value only when Resend was actually called, or raise a sentinel exception in preview mode, then have safety_digest_send_now key sent off that signal.

issues: KPI tile elements lack data-testid prefixed with 'digest-kpi-' as documented in the spec — recommend adding data-testid for each KPI tile for testability (currently must rely on text labels).

action_items: Fix _safety_send_email wrapper / safety_digest_send_now contract so `sent` reflects actual Resend dispatch (must be false in preview env with AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false).
Add data-testid='digest-kpi-<key>' attributes on each Weekly Digest KPI tile for testability (cosmetic / testability nit).
critical_code_review_comments: safety_portal.py is now ~1020 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routes/safety_portal/{auth.py, fire_ext.py, documents.py, training.py, digest.py, admin.py}.

Document upload stores file_data inline as base64 in MongoDB (15MB limit). Works for small docs but does not scale beyond a few hundred docs per category — recommend migrating to object storage (S3/Spaces) before prod load.
Digest /send endpoint blindly sets sent=True if send_email_fn doesn't raise. Tighten the contract (return value or explicit exception in stub mode) so the API response is honest.

rca of the issue: RCA for digest sent-flag bug: build_safety_router → safety_digest_send_now does `await send_email_fn(...)` and sets sent=True if no exception. The injected wrapper _safety_send_email (server.py:8111) short-circuits with a log line and silent `return` when AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS!='true' OR RESEND_API_KEY is missing. Therefore in preview env no exception is raised → sent=True incorrectly. Mitigation: have _safety_send_email return False (or raise a custom 'EmailDisabled' exception caught by the endpoint) when it short-circuits, and update safety_digest_send_now to set sent only when the return value is truthy.
